product_overview: GloHealth AI is a full-stack healthcare web application that helps users assess symptoms with AI, find and book doctors, and explore disease trends across Bangladesh. It also provides subscription plans, bilingual support, and admin tools for managing the platform.
core_goals: Assess symptoms and receive an AI-based disease prediction with confidence and guidance
Browse verified doctors and book appointments with available consultation slots
View geospatial disease trends and outbreak patterns across Bangladesh
Subscribe to a care plan that provides consultation benefits and checkup points
Switch the interface between English and Bengali
Allow administrators to manage users, doctors, appointments, settings, and audit logs

features.name: Landing Page and Navigation
features.description: The public homepage introduces the platform, highlights key health features, and provides navigation to core sections such as symptom checking, doctors, plans, and language selection.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the platform overview and feature highlights -> Choose symptom checking, doctors, or plans to continue to a relevant section
Navigate to / -> Switch the interface language -> See the page content update to the selected language

features.name: User Authentication and Account Management
features.description: Users can create an account, sign in with email and password, and sign out of the platform.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter name, email, password, division, district, and postal code -> Submit the registration form -> See the account created and the dashboard opened
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard opened
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See a sign-in error message
Navigate to /logout -> See the session end and return to the homepage

features.name: Clinical Symptom Assessment and AI Prediction
features.description: Authenticated users can select symptoms, provide location details, and receive an AI-generated disease prediction with confidence and recommendations.
user_flows: Navigate to /prediction -> Select one or more symptoms -> Enter or confirm division details -> Submit the assessment -> See the prediction results page with the top disease, confidence, and advice
Navigate to /prediction -> Select symptoms and location details -> Submit the assessment -> See the feature explanation showing the symptoms that influenced the prediction
Navigate to /prediction -> Try to submit without selecting any symptoms -> See validation prevent submission until at least one symptom is chosen

features.name: Prediction Results and Insights
features.description: Users can review the predicted condition, confidence level, severity guidance, and explanation of the most influential symptoms.
user_flows: Navigate to /results -> Review the predicted disease and confidence score -> Read the explanation and medical guidance -> Choose to consult a doctor

features.name: Doctor Directory and Appointment Booking
features.description: Users can search verified doctors, filter by specialty and division, view doctor details, and book appointments using a future time slot and a payment or plan-point option.
user_flows: Navigate to /doctors -> Search for a doctor by name or hospital -> Filter by specialty and division -> Review the matching doctor cards

Navigate to /doctors -> Open a doctor profile from the listing -> Proceed to the booking page -> Choose a future date and available time slot -> Add the reason for the visit -> Confirm the booking -> See the appointment appear in the appointments list
Navigate to /appointments -> Review booked appointments and their status -> Cancel a pending or future appointment -> See the appointment status update to cancelled

features.name: Geospatial Health Insights
features.description: Authenticated users can explore division-level disease prevalence and outbreak trends on an interactive Bangladesh health dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /geo_insights -> Select a disease filter -> Review the map, divisional risk levels, and outbreak metrics -> Compare trends across divisions and months

features.name: Subscription Plans and Care Benefits
features.description: Users can compare health plans, activate a subscription, and cancel an active subscription when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /plans -> Compare the available plan tiers -> Open a plan detail view -> Review consultation allowances and benefits
Navigate to /plans -> Select a plan to subscribe -> Confirm the subscription -> See the active plan and checkup points update
Navigate to /plans -> Open the active subscription -> Cancel the subscription -> See the plan stop renewing while retained benefits remain available for the billing period

features.name: Bilingual Localization
features.description: Users can switch the application language between English and Bengali across interface labels and clinical content.
user_flows: Navigate to /set_language/en -> Return to the interface in English
Navigate to /set_language/bn -> Return to the interface in Bengali

features.name: Administrative Governance
features.description: Administrators can manage users, doctors, appointments, system settings, and audit exports from a protected admin portal.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> Review platform metrics and recent activity -> Open management sections for users, doctors, or appointments
Navigate to /admin/users -> Select a user to edit -> Update profile details -> Save the changes -> See the user list reflect the update
Navigate to /admin/doctors -> Add a new doctor with specialty, division, fee, and availability -> Save the record -> See the doctor appear in the registry
Navigate to /admin/appointments -> Open an appointment for editing -> Change its status or schedule -> Save the update -> See the appointment list reflect the new values
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Update site name, support email, or base consultation fee -> Save the settings -> See the updated configuration persist
Navigate to /admin/export_audit -> Download the audit log export

code_summary.name: GloHealth_Ai
code_summary.description: GloHealth AI is a full-stack AI-driven healthcare and symptom reporting web application built with Flask, Supabase, and scikit-learn. It allows users to assess symptoms, receive ML-driven disease predictions, book doctor appointments, explore geospatial disease trends, and manage subscriptions, with dedicated admin management features.

machine_learning.capabilities: Symptom-based inference, Location boosting, Seasonal adjustment

features.name: Landing and Navigation
features.description: Home landing page introducing GloHealth AI capabilities, quick start assessment trigger, feature overview, statistics, and header/footer navigation.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User authentication via Supabase Auth and Flask-Login session management, supporting both dedicated login/register pages and responsive modal dialogs.

features.name: Symptom Assessment and Prediction
features.description: Interactive clinical assessment form where users select reported symptoms, provide location/demographics, and submit for ML prediction.

features.name: Prediction Results and Insights
features.description: Display predicted disease, confidence level, recommended actions, and feature importance explanations.

features.name: Doctor Directory and Booking
features.description: Search and filter verified doctors by specialty and division, pick date/time slots to book appointments, and view user appointments list.

features.name: Geospatial Insights
features.description: Interactive public health epidemiology dashboard displaying division-level disease prevalence, outbreak monitoring, and geospatial metrics.

features.name: Subscription Plans
features.description: Tiered subscription tiers (Free, Plus, Pro) with checkup points and mock payment integration.

features.name: Bilingual Localization
features.description: Language switcher supporting English (en) and Bengali (bn) across clinical terms and interface elements.

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Administrative portal to manage users, doctors, appointments, and global system settings.
